subject: Re: Kickoff: Distracting Control as our RL robustness gate
body:
Ulla,

Staffing and setup.

May: Amara 40% on integration -- suite.load with the dm_control domain/task plus difficulty and the DAVIS dataset path slots into our training stack cleanly, and she has the DAVIS 2017 480p images staged. Farah 30% on CI wiring so the benchmark runs nightly. Hyun 20% advising on which difficulty tiers matter for the gate.

June is the heavy benchmarking month: Nikhil Abebe is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 to run the full difficulty-sweep benchmark. That sweep is every current agent across all difficulty tiers and all three distraction types, so it needs a committed owner, not spare cycles. Tereza supports at 30% on analysis.

Compute: benchmark evals are cheap individually but the matrix is large -- estimating 20k GPU-hours on Titan spread over June.

Ivo
